directives.name: prop
directives.description: Public component property. Becomes a kebab-cased attribute on the host. Read as `NAME()`, written as `NAME.set(v)`. `!` marks required.

anti_examples.reason: Type annotation required for typed reactivity.

directives.name: state
directives.description: Local signal. Same `NAME()` / `NAME.set(v)` access as props.

directives.name: derived
directives.description: Memoised computed signal. Re-runs on any reactive read inside `EXPR`. Auto-tracked.

directives.name: data
directives.description: Server-sourced signal — implicitly live. Subscribed via SSE; initial value is `null`. RHS must be a `ship.*` schema-source call. For local seed, use `state`.

anti_examples.reason: RHS must be `ship.<domain>.<op>(...)`. Use `state` for seed.

directives.name: function
directives.description: Plain JS in component scope. Has access to all injected scope bindings.

directives.name: event
directives.description: Typed CustomEvent declaration. Surfaces in the `.d.ts` as a known dispatch target.

directives.name: component_form_associated
directives.description: Element-level config. Attaches `ElementInternals` and exposes it as `internals`. Required before any `on form_*` hook.

scope_bindings.name: el
scope_bindings.description: The host custom element instance. Use for `el.dispatchEvent`, `el.querySelector`, `el.setAttribute`, etc.

scope_bindings.name: internals
scope_bindings.description: Set when `component formAssociated` is declared. Use for `internals.setFormValue(...)` and friends.

scope_bindings.name: props
scope_bindings.description: Read-only proxy. `props.X` is `X()` — alternate access shape.

scope_bindings.name: cleanups
scope_bindings.description: Push disposers for `mount`-time setup that needs teardown. The runtime calls them on unmount.

scope_bindings.name: slotFilled
scope_bindings.description: Returns true iff the named slot received caller-provided content.

lifecycle_hooks.name: mount
lifecycle_hooks.fires: Once on `connectedCallback` after the DOM is wired.
lifecycle_hooks.description: One-time setup. Push to `cleanups` for subscriptions that need teardown.

lifecycle_hooks.name: effect
lifecycle_hooks.fires: On any reactive read inside the body changing.
lifecycle_hooks.description: Auto-tracked. The parser also accepts `effect on X { … }` and `effect once { … }`, but auto-tracking is the preferred shape — `effect on X` is redundant whenever the body already reads `X()`.

lifecycle_hooks.name: form_reset
lifecycle_hooks.fires: When the parent `<form>` is reset (form-associated only).

lifecycle_hooks.name: form_restore
lifecycle_hooks.fires: When the browser restores form state (BFCache / autofill).
lifecycle_hooks.description: Lifecycle hook for `formStateRestoreCallback`. Param name pulls from `e.detail.<param>`.

lifecycle_hooks.name: form_disabled
lifecycle_hooks.fires: When the host form's `disabled` state toggles.

template_syntax.name: interpolation
template_syntax.description: Reactive text interpolation. Re-renders the text node when any signal read inside `EXPR` changes.

template_syntax.name: attribute_interpolation
template_syntax.description: Reactive attribute. Empty / null / undefined / `false` auto-omit. `true` becomes presence-only.

template_syntax.name: event_attribute
template_syntax.description: Any `on*` attr with an interpolated value is an event listener. Use platform names; `on:click` prefix is removed.

template_syntax.name: two_way_binding
template_syntax.description: Two-way binding for form inputs. The runtime owns the input listener.

template_syntax.name: bind_callback
template_syntax.description: Side-effect callback for `bind:value`. After the runtime writes the signal on user input, `FN(newValue)` fires — for dispatching public events, syncing form state, etc. Not invoked on programmatic signal writes. Pair with `bind:value` only.

template_syntax.name: if_block
template_syntax.description: Mustache control flow. `:elif` is also accepted as shorthand.

template_syntax.name: for_block
template_syntax.description: List rendering. Optional `key={EXPR}` for stable identity.

template_syntax.name: await_block
template_syntax.description: Async control flow. Loading branch until the promise settles.

template_syntax.name: raw_html
template_syntax.description: Raw HTML interpolation. Author owns sanitisation.

template_syntax.name: slot
template_syntax.description: Light-DOM slot. Body is the fallback when no caller content arrives.

template_syntax.name: slot_fill
template_syntax.syntax: slot="NAME" on a child of a custom-element call
template_syntax.description: Routes a child into the named slot of the consumed component. The `slot=` attr is stripped after distribution; query via `slotFilled(el, 'name')`.

template_syntax.name: host_attrs
template_syntax.description: Reactive bindings on the component's host element. Replaces the `mount + effect + el.setAttribute` ritual. Self-closing only.

template_syntax.name: style_external
template_syntax.description: External stylesheet. Inlined at compile time.

template_syntax.name: component_call
template_syntax.description: Custom-element invocation. Resolved against the registry.

reactivity_rules.name: signal_call_required
reactivity_rules.description: Reading a signal in expression context requires `()`. Bare identifiers reference the signal accessor itself.

reactivity_rules.name: no_signal_set_in_template
reactivity_rules.description: Mutations belong in handlers, not templates.

reactivity_rules.name: prefer_auto_tracked_effect
reactivity_rules.description: `effect` auto-tracks reactive reads. The legacy `effect on X { … }` form still parses but is redundant whenever the body reads `X()`; prefer the bare form.

reactivity_rules.name: platform_event_attrs
reactivity_rules.description: Event handlers use platform attribute names. `on:click` prefix is removed.

reactivity_rules.name: no_bind_with_oninput
reactivity_rules.description: `bind:value` already attaches an input listener. Don't pair with `oninput`.

reactivity_rules.name: data_is_implicitly_live
reactivity_rules.description: `data` is server-sourced and always live. Static seeds use `state X = expr`.
